kind: Technical client transport review; no factual teaching or legal content changed
scope: Ranked QuizClient profile lookup, round start, answer, next and synchronization: one bounded client request from fetch through the complete JSON response.

originalObservation.method: Actual React DOM and effects with isolated pending fetch/JSON promises at each of five stages. After300000ms of controlled component time every stage retained its busy view without an application deadline or retry state; actual unmount cancellation already worked.
originalObservation.limit: Controlled component time is not a measurement of five real minutes of production traffic or a physical-device test.

covers: parent abort before or during either await
change.mechanism: Each request owns a child AbortController, a parent abort listener and a total deadline. Promise.race releases the UI even when a synthetic transport ignores cancellation. Owned timer and listener are removed on every completed path; delayed callbacks cannot affect another request.
change.retry: The existing stage-specific error and explicit Erneut versuchen action remain. No automatic retry is added. Round/answer/next UUIDs and entire operation payloads are reused exactly on explicit retries.
change.serverLimit: Aborting client transport is not a guarantee that an already accepted server operation was rolled back. The existing idempotent request identity is therefore preserved.
change.privacy: Private abort reasons and transport failures are not displayed; existing bounded HTTP error/status handling and stage-specific public messages remain.

preserved: Server30-second question timing, scoring, completed results and idempotency
Profile readiness, explicit URL country policy, country/topic selection identities and A-B-A guards
Session storage keys and round UUID reuse
Blind questions, one-shot answer locking, manual Weiter and readable feedback
Existing authentication, paid access, cookies, origin checks, database functions and provider order
All teaching texts, sources, questions, cards and scientific review dates

regressions.fiveStageMatrix: Profile/start/answer/next/sync each with pending fetch and pending JSON, deadline at7999/8000ms, explicit successful retry, exact UUID/payload, inert late data and cleaned resources.
additional: Actual unmount while fetch or JSON is pending
A-B-A legal selection with retained old timer and retry actions
Already-aborted and active-aborted parents with private reasons
Native streamed Response headers at7999ms followed by a hanging JSON body
A completed request's retained timer cannot cancel its successor in the same selection
Successful blind round retains the exact30-second unanswered-question transition
regressions.existingHarnessAdjustment: One existing run-ui harness loads the actual helper with its existing synthetic timer. Its formerly unbounded60-second pending-answer case now asserts the8-second error and an explicit retry of exactly the same answer:null operation; late original feedback is rejected and all prior blind/locking/score/manual-feedback checks remain. The subsequent request count correctly includes this one explicit retry.
regressions.authorRun: Three targeted suites:34 passed,0 failed,0 skipped,0 cancelled. Broader checks and independent review are performed separately.
